title.zh: 【Coinbase 将暂停 Balancer（BAL）和 Tensor（TNSR）交易】
title.en: 【Coinbase 将暂停 Balancer（BAL）和 Tensor（TNSR）交易】

current_state.zh: Coinbase Markets will suspend trading of Balancer (BAL) and Tensor (TNSR) on November 10 at 03:00 Beijing time, with both order books already restricted to limit-only mode while user assets remain withdrawable.
current_state.en: Coinbase Markets will suspend trading of Balancer (BAL) and Tensor (TNSR) on November 10 at 03:00 Beijing time, with both order books already restricted to limit-only mode while user assets remain withdrawable.
